observations: All six named views are present, legible and uncropped. The two side profiles show three tires, matching the specified three-axle/six-wheel design.
One rounded blue cabin, one orange articulated crane, rear open log bunk, mixed load, grapple with guarded upper saw cassette, and grounded forest/lakeshore working state are visible.
At work the grapple holds a log above the bunk; this is an illustration of the intended action, not proof of grasp/contact animation.

defects.finding: The stone crate moves from immediately behind the cab in RIGHT to the far rear in LEFT, THREE-QUARTER and AT WORK. The cardinals therefore do not share the same representative travel load arrangement.
defects.repair: In RIGHT only, place the stone crate at the far rear/left and the logs between crate and cab, preserving chassis, crane and all other panels.
